convert_audio_tensor: convert a PyTorch audio tensor to a target sample rate and channel count using torchaudio resampling
save_audio_tensor: save a PyTorch audio tensor to a WAV file with optional rescaling and 16-bit PCM encoding
overlap_add_frames: merge overlapping audio frames with linear fade-in and fade-out weighting using a triangular envelope
check_file_checksum: verify the SHA256 checksum of a file and raise an error if it does not match the expected value
build_checkpoint_url: construct a full checkpoint download URL by combining a root URL with a checkpoint filename
